auditReferences.quote: 元康十年（300年）正月一日，改元為永康元年。
auditReferences.reason: Yuankang ends at New Year AD 300. The same page’s month table starts 元康九年十二月 on 300/1/8, so the chapter’s 十二月 events are AD 300, not the conventional 299 reign-year label. Western year-level values here do not flip between Julian and proleptic Gregorian.

auditReferences.reason: Yongkang 1 is AD 300. The page table places 正月 on 2/7, 三月 on 4/6, and 六月 on 7/3, all inside AD 300, supporting 明年正月, the March murder, and the sixth-month burial.

auditReferences.title: 永宁 (西晋)
auditReferences.quote: 永宁（ 301年四月—302年十一月）是西晋皇帝晋惠帝司马衷的第五个年号
auditReferences.reason: Yongning corresponds to AD 301–302. 永甯/永寧元年正月 and 八月 therefore convert to AD 301.

auditReferences.reason: Tai’an was proclaimed in the twelfth month of Yongning 2, but Jin Shu headings treat 太安元年 as the civil year AD 302, so 太安元年三月 and 太安初 stay AD 302.
